items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Ronnie' in a conversational aside ('...during the war. And I would take three pieces and then, in practice, we'd play a marcher with three pieces. Then the fellow would play with six pieces.') but does not describe a specific professional or personal relationship with this

ctx.x: You want the bands- Well, we had several set-ups. Well, I'll tell you- Well, I'll tell you- Well, we had several set-ups. Well, I'll tell you- For three pieces.

So for that one, we had a couple of pieces. And then we had a couple of pieces. And then we had a couple of pieces. And so forth. I had several aggregations of my own. But I would take- I don't want- The first part would start by three pieces, Ronnie, during the war. And I would take three pieces and then, in practice, we'd play a marcher with three pieces. Then the fellow would play with six pieces.
What else did you use besides the sax?
